paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: GrAHal pathfinder haloscope run (July 2021) at liquid He temperature. New measured exclusion limit g_agamma <= 2.2e-13 GeV^-1 (22x KSVZ) at m_a ~ 26.37 ueV (6.375 GHz TM010 cavity), 95% CL. The limit spans only a very narrow frequency band (a few He-gas tuning steps around 6.375 GHz shown in Fig. 4, not tabulated), so a single representative point is given from the explicit text value. Paper assumes axions constitute all of the local DM density but does not quote the numeric value; 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is the standard haloscope convention (as used by ADMX/HAYSTAC analyses it follows) and is entered as the assumed density.
